name: New to databases
title: New to databases
text: A complete prerequisite path from SQL meaning to single-machine scans, joins and aggregation.
assumes: Basic programming and SQL; no database-internals background.

name: Working data engineer
title: Working data engineer
text: Execution models, joins, optimization, distributed work and lakehouse storage.
assumes: Working SQL and the foundations in Modules 00–04 and expression semantics in 06. Follow Read first links to fill gaps.

name: Preparing for engine roles
title: Preparing for engine roles
text: Hardware, execution, memory, shuffle and a working engine.
assumes: Relational semantics, representation, frontend, expressions and optimization. Follow each module’s Read first links before skipping ahead.
